name: FoundationalASSIST
summary: 1.7 million interactions of 5,000 grade 6 to 8 students with 3,395 math problems in ASSISTments, with the problems' text, students' first answers, hint requests and skills.

license.note: Non-commercial, for research and education under ASSISTments' responsible use guidelines.

access_note: Gated on Hugging Face: a form asking for affiliation and intended use, reviewed weekly.
cite: Worden, E., Heffernan, C., Heffernan, N., & Sonkar, S. (2026). FoundationalASSIST: An Educational Dataset for Foundational Knowledge Tracing and Pedagogical Grounding of LLMs. arXiv:2602.00070

fits.how: Its real answer sequences could check mastery measures, and its students' wrong answers could test which errors a simulated learner reproduces.
